login.title: Sign in to Cohive
login.name: Username
login.blocked: This account can't sign in right now. Contact a server admin.
login.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
login.cliHint: You can also run cohive web on a computer that's already signed in to open this page without a password.
login.noAccount: No account yet? Ask an admin for an invite link and register from it. If you forgot your password, ask a server admin to reset it.

register.title: Join Cohive
register.busy: Too many requests. Wait a moment, then try again.

summary.personal: Personal invite: ready to use as soon as you join.
summary.team: Team invite: an admin must approve you before you can join.

joined.already: You ({{account}}) are already a member of workspace {{workspace}}, so you don't need this invite.
joined.pending: Join request submitted. Waiting for an admin of workspace {{workspace}} to approve it. Once approved, it will appear in the workspace list in the top bar.
joined.signedInAs: You're signed in as <m>{{account}}</m>. If you accept the invite, this account becomes a member of the workspace. No new account is created.
joined.needPassword: Accepting an invite requires signing in with a username and password. You opened this page without a password from a paired computer (cohive web), so for security you can't accept an invite here.
joined.signOutAndLogin: Sign out and sign in with a password
joined.mustChange: <l>Change your password</l> first. You'll come back here afterwards.
joined.notYou: Not your account? Sign out and switch accounts

invalid.title: This invite link isn't valid. It may have expired, been revoked, or run out of uses.
invalid.hint: Ask an admin for a new invite link. If you already have an account, just sign in.

form.nameError: Use only lowercase letters, digits, underscores and hyphens, 1 to 32 characters, starting with a letter or digit.
form.passwordError: The password must be at least {{min}} characters.
form.name: Username
form.nameHint: Unique across the whole server. Used to sign in and to be assigned issues, and can't be changed after registering. Lowercase letters, digits, underscores and hyphens, 1 to 32 characters.
form.displayNameHint: The name your teammates see on the board. Optional.
form.submitted: Submitted. Waiting for an admin to approve. Once approved, sign in with username <m>{{name}}</m> and the password you just set.
form.haveAccount: Already have an account? <l>Sign in to join</l> instead of registering again.

password.title: Change password
password.forced: For account security, set a new password first. You can use the rest of the app after that.
password.nextError: The new password must be at least {{min}} characters.
password.confirmError: The two new passwords don't match.
password.done: Password changed. Sessions in other browsers are signed out, so sign in again with the new password.
password.oldHint: You haven't set a password yet (for example, you signed in with a passwordless link), so you can leave this empty.

device.title: Authorize this computer to sign in
device.needPassword: Authorizing a new computer requires signing in with a username and password. You opened this page without a password from a paired computer (cohive web), so for security you can't authorize here. After you sign in with a password, you'll come back to this page.
device.gone: This authorization link is invalid or has expired. Run cohive login again in your terminal to get a new link.
device.name: Device name
device.warnTitle: Only authorize a sign-in you just started yourself in a terminal.
device.warnBody: If you didn't run cohive login on your own computer, or someone else sent you this link, click Deny. Once authorized, this device can act on issues as you.
device.firstDevice: This is your first device. It takes effect as soon as you authorize it.
device.needsAdmin: You've paired a device before (including revoked ones), so after you authorize this new device it also needs approval from an admin of your workspace before it can be used.
device.authorizeAs: This computer will be authorized as account {{who}}.
device.scopeNone: You aren't in any workspace right now. After you authorize, this computer can be used for a workspace once an admin adds you to it.
device.scopeList: Once approved, this computer can be used for: {{workspaces}}.

result.approved: Authorized. Go back to your terminal.
result.delivered: Authorized. The terminal has finished signing in.
result.awaiting_admin: Submitted. Waiting for an admin of your workspace to approve. If the terminal is still open, it finishes automatically after approval. If you closed it, run cohive login --resume on that computer after approval to pick it up.
result.denied: Denied. This sign-in won't take effect.
result.expired: This authorization request has expired. Run cohive login again in your terminal.
